278831302.description: This lot includes three vintage wooden smoking pipes featuring dark brown and black finishes. Each pipe has a classic stem design, including straight and slightly bent shapes, with vulcanite or plastic mouthpieces. The bowls show charring and residue, and the wood surfaces exhibit varying patina from age and use. These pipes have no visible brand markings or model numbers and present a well-worn character.

278671664.description: This lot includes five vintage tobacco pipes made primarily of briar wood, featuring stems crafted from vulcanite and acrylic materials. The pipes display visible brand markings such as Algerian Briar, London Made England, Made in London England, and Shanwell. Each pipe shows signs of wear, including discoloration and residue inside the bowls, while the wood grain and craftsmanship remain apparent. One pipe is distinguished by a marbled amber stem, adding to the variety in this collection.

Optional Title:
Pair of Vintage Clear Glass Electrical Insulators
Category:

Description:
Enhance your historical collection with this pair of vintage clear glass insulators, classic relics from the era of telegraph and telephone lines. Each insulator displays iconic, rounded contours and subtle amber tinting, showcasing glass craftsmanship from the early-to-mid 20th century. Perfect for collectors or as unique decor, the insulators' robust construction and preserved clarity highlight both their utility and nostalgic charm. Place them on a shelf, use them as paperweights, or incorporate them into upcycled art projects for an industrial twist. These pieces come gently used, with no major chips or cracks visible, and offer a glimpse into utility history with their original patina. Shop confidently knowing these genuine insulators are excellent examples for display, conversation, and educational purposes. Add a distinctive touch to your home or office with this timeless pair a piece of everyday heritage you can hold in your hands.
